verdict.rationale: FreeAgent is accounting and invoicing SaaS with a REST/OAuth API, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent or assistant surface that could host MCP servers, so the exception for wrong-axis capabilities does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
